name: MMR-Bench
description:
MMR-Bench is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate multimodal LLM routing under diverse settings.
It supports systematic comparison across scenarios and provides analysis beyond single-dataset evaluation (e.g., cost–accuracy trade-offs, cross-dataset generalization, and modality transfer).
evaluation_method: accuracy (routing correctness) and cost–accuracy trade-off / composite cost-normalized accuracy
general_score_metric: accuracy (with cost–accuracy trade-off composite as a primary analysis metric)
reputation: Emerging research benchmark hosted on Hugging Face for evaluating multimodal LLM routing and modality-allocation strategies; gaining attention in multimodal systems work.
